question: Where was the foundation stone for the new Central Ayurveda Research Institute building laid by PM Modi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohini, New Delhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **PM Modi laid the foundation stone for the new Central Ayurveda Research Institute building at Rohini, New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The new Central Ayurveda Research Institute will feature a state-of-the-art facility spanning 2.92 acres.**
 
• A 100-bed research hospital will be included to advance Ayurveda research.
 
• The construction cost for the new building is estimated at Rs 185 crore.
 
• The Central Ayurveda Research Institute was initially established in 1979.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Central Ayurveda Research Institute__

 __
 
• Established in: 1979
 
• Location: Rohini, New Delhi
 
• Focus: Advancing research in Ayurveda and promoting traditional medicine.
 
 
 
• Ayurveda__
 
 
• Definition: An ancient Indian system of medicine focused on holistic healing.
 
• Significance: Recognized globally for its contributions to wellness and alternative medicine.
